title: Heartbeat Monitor Config
description: The JSON Schema for the config file. It matches the `ClientConfig` models in `heartbeat_monitor/config.py`.

path.description: Path to the database file. If you omit this key, the program uses the default location.

cleanup_days.description: Number of days to keep data. The default is 30.

interval.description: Probe interval, in seconds. The value must be more than 0. The default is 5.0.

timeout.description: Timeout for each request, in seconds. The value must be more than 0. The default is 1.0.

servers.description: Servers to probe. Each [[servers]] table describes one server.

level.description: Logging level. The default is INFO.

file.description: Path to the log file. If you omit this key, the program writes to stdout or stderr.

max_size_mb.description: Maximum size of one log file, in megabytes. The default is 10.

backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep. The default is 5.
